name: Plane
author: makeplane
description: Self-hosted Linear/Jira: issues, cycles and pages. Plane Community v1.4.2 behind an HTTP-only proxy on :8105 (Serve terminates TLS; we do not publish :443). First instance admin is seeded from .env. Eleven long-running containers plus a one-shot migrator — RAM-heavy on this 7.7 GB box. MinIO comes from quay.io because Docker Hub froze minio/minio. This is our compose, not a wrap of Plane's interactive setup.sh.

control._comment: Stop order: proxy first, then the UI/API tier, then MinIO/RabbitMQ/Valkey, then Postgres. Migrator is one-shot and is not in this list. Start is the reverse.
